annotations.title: Books like one the user enjoyed, or for a genre

description: Books Like This. Books like one the user enjoyed, or for a genre. For requests like "books like The Martian" or "a good cosy mystery". Suggestions are English-language books for the same readers (picture book, children, young adult or adult), one per author and one per series. Well-read books of the same kind come first (picked_from: shelf, and because names the kind, for example "celebrated dystopian novels"), then books sharing specific subjects on Open Library (picked_from: subjects, and because lists the shared subjects). Novels never get self-help, textbooks, anthologies, study guides, category romance lines or explicit books as suggestions, and popular books are preferred over obscure ones. Other books by the same author are left out unless same_author=true. Give title or subject; common other titles work (1984, The Sorcerer's Stone)

author.description: The author's name, to pin down the right book or list their books.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the shop links, for example US or GB.

same_author.description: True to include more books by the same author.

subject.description: A genre or theme, for example space opera, cozy mystery, heist.

title.description: A book the user liked, 2 to 120 characters.
